decisions.reason: Restricting available theme colors does not change the candidate's font sizes, emphasis, or caption typography.
The palette restriction is independently represented by the source Requirement and does not alter the candidate's required style source, cross-template coverage, or listed style additions.
Theme-color availability does not affect the rule preventing extra borders when Board Meeting rows are extended.
The source does not revoke the required green level-4 bullet or change bullet size, spacing, balance, or alignment; it only restricts the broader palette of selectable colors.
The color-option restriction does not change hard-return spacing, Shift+Enter expectations, or line-break behavior.
The fixed-margin and graphic-clipping requirements remain valid unchanged regardless of which theme colors are available.
Restricting theme colors does not alter multiline entry behavior or the designated interactive fields.
The palette decision does not affect placeholder clearing behavior or its template contexts.
Theme-color availability does not resolve or modify Tab-controlled list hierarchy and alignment behavior.
The color palette restriction does not change field-label language, text, placement, persistence, or coverage.
The selection of approved theme colors does not affect the editable-field mechanism or legacy-field handling.
Restricting selectable theme colors does not change the required legacy copy-paste workflow, test sources, or target template version.
